# youtrack_project_app (Resource)

YouTrack project app resource. Attaches an installed app to a project and enables or disables it there. Workflows are apps too, so this is also how a workflow is attached to a project. Attaching an app to a template project makes projects created from that template inherit it. An app that is already attached to the project is adopted instead of attached a second time, and destroying the resource detaches it whether or not Terraform attached it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "youtrack_project" "scrum_template" {
  name         = "Scrum template"
  short_name   = "SCRUMTPL"
  leader_login = "john.doe"
  template     = true
}

# Attach a workflow to the template, so every project created from it inherits
# the workflow. Workflows are apps: app_name is the package name listed by
# GET /api/admin/apps, not the title shown in the UI.
resource "youtrack_project_app" "subtasks" {
  project_id = youtrack_project.scrum_template.id
  app_name   = "@jetbrains/youtrack-workflow-subtasks"
  enabled    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_name` (String) The name of the installed app, as listed by `GET /api/admin/apps` (for example `@jetbrains/youtrack-workflow-due-date`). This is the package name, not the title shown in the UI.
- `project_id` (String) The entity ID of the project to attach the app to (for example `0-1`), not its short name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app is enabled in the project. Defaults to `true`; an app disabled outside of Terraform is enabled again on the next apply.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) The entity ID of the app. It changes when the app is uninstalled and installed again.
- `id` (String) The entity ID of the app usage, the record that attaches the app to the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import an app attachment using the composite ID: {project_id}/{app_name}
# The app name may itself contain a slash, as in this example.
terraform import youtrack_project_app.subtasks <PROJECT_ID>/@jetbrains/youtrack-workflow-subtasks
```
